items.difficulty_reason: H2: the author applies the explicitly attributed elliptic Riccati normal form, computes the two theta divisors over the quadratic elliptic cover, turns their weight identity into a parameter-lattice relation, and derives different degree inequalities in cases A and B. This forces all Riccati factors to be constant; the remaining poles and nonzero nu exclude that constant solution. The specialized divisor/weight calculation and two parameter regimes are supplied in full, rather than assumed from general Galois theory.
